# Reconcile Incremental Compilation

The reconcile function reprocesses merged pull requests and direct commits in a repository based on their timestamps. It ensures that all relevant changes are accounted for and allows for managing the state of the compile runs incrementally.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
